items.title: 習近平七年來首次訪印前瞻：中印回暖背後的美國陰影與西藏問題
items.desc: 這次訪問的時機耐人尋味。金磚機制被視為美國主導的世界格局之外的另一種選擇，美國總統特朗普（Donald Trump）已多次對其發出威脅；與此同時，中印兩國在貿易、直航和邊界對話上悄然回溫。

items.title: 香港支聯會「煽動顛覆」案：李卓人、鄒幸彤、何俊仁判囚5至7年
items.desc: 三人早於2021年9月被起訴，分別被判囚5至7年。支聯會早前已宣告解散，結束32年歷史。有香港市民在庭外排隊旁聽，表示過去幾十年曾參加六四燭光晚會，形容案件猶如「對我的控訴」。

items.title: 香港支聯會「煽動顛覆」案：被告們的伴侶與戰友
items.desc: 香港支聯會「煽顛」案歷經五年，三名核心人物的判刑結果塵埃落定。BBC中文訪問李卓人的妻子鄧燕娥及鄒幸彤戰友劉家儀，講述他們如何面對香港的變遷和怎樣陪伴在牆內的人。

items.title: 911事件25年後 美國機場安檢醞釀「鬆綁」
items.desc: 美國民眾很快將能再次到登機門送別親友，這是相關改革措施的一部分。

items.title: 間諜、戰略與錯失的機會：911的教訓至今仍在消化
items.desc: 25年後回望，這場襲擊已塑造了整整一代的外交、安全及情報政策。BBC安全事務記者如此寫道。

items.title: 「無時無刻都在想」：911事件25年後審訊仍未了，難屬傷痛難癒
items.desc: 四分之一個世紀過去了，被指策劃這場襲擊的主謀審訊仍未展開，遇難者家屬擔心，等待正義的時間已經所剩不多。

items.title: 911事件25週年：震驚世界的襲擊如何發生，造成多少人死亡？
items.desc: 2001年的襲擊造成數千名美國人喪生，並對全球產生了深遠影響。

items.title: 青島北海造船廠外籍貨輪大火 失聯25人已確定全部死亡
items.desc: 中國官方媒體稱，一艘外籍貨輪靠港維修期間起火，造成嚴重傷亡。習近平與李強下達救災指示。

items.title: 特朗普真的能向每位美國成年人發放5000美元嗎？
items.desc: 分析人士質疑，美國總統在選舉年提出的這項承諾，是否可行、合法且負擔得起。

items.title: 香港記協主席訴《華爾街日報》解僱案 法庭判局部有罪
items.desc: 香港記者協會主席鄭嘉如指控《華爾街日報》出版商道瓊斯，因其參與工會活動，而將其革職，法庭部分支持其主張。

items.title: AI「性轉」視頻風靡中國網絡：一場「 新文化運動」的覺醒與侷限
items.desc: 經典的「好太太」系列廣告以「好丈夫」的形象重出江湖：鏡頭前穿著清涼的不再是女性,而是男性。

items.title: 推崇⽑澤東的「Z世代」：彈幕、「教員」與政治失語
items.desc: 從2019年開始，《毛澤東選集》突然躍居清華大學圖書館年度借閱榜榜首，此後一直到2025年都穩居榜首。網絡上，不少年輕人稱毛澤東為「教員」，並追捧他的影視形象。為何這位已故領導人重新受到關注？

items.title: 2026台灣地方選舉：「九合一」為何重要？選舉時程是什麼？
items.desc: 台灣的地方選舉又稱「九合一」選舉，每四年一次，多數落在總統任期中段的年底，故被視為總統的「期中考」。

items.title: 尼泊爾給水力發電押下重注，泥石流把問題徹底暴露
items.desc: 一場喜馬拉雅山冰岩崩造成的泥石流，摧毀了尼泊爾超過10%的發電能力。

items.title: 尼泊爾—西藏泥石流：堰塞湖和冰湖是下一個「定時炸彈」？
items.desc: 事發河谷上游已形成兩個堰塞湖。與此同時，原本散佈在喜馬拉雅山區的冰川湖，在災區內有10座被標記為高風險，專家形容它們是「定時炸彈」。

items.title: 泥石流摧毀西藏吉隆口岸的關鍵幾分鐘
items.desc: 吉隆口岸位處西藏與尼泊爾的重要貿易通路之上，中國與尼泊爾兩側各有數以百計外國旅客在泥石流衝擊後下落不明。

items.title: 中國審查西藏口岸遭洪災衝擊畫面，當地災民情況我們所知甚少
items.desc: 一些關於這場致命山洪暴發最驚人的畫面，中國官方媒體未對公眾播放。

items.title: 專訪鄧燕娥：與李卓人相伴四十年「互相撐著」
items.desc: 已解散的香港市民支援愛國民主運動聯合會（支聯會）被控「煽動他人顛覆國家政權」案正式宣判，前主席李卓人被定罪判刑7年。

items.title: 為甚麼我們會記錯911事件？
items.desc: 記憶可能是錯的？911事件發生後，大部分人也許能清楚記得自己當時身在何處，以及是如何得知這消息。其他重大新聞事件也有類似的鮮明記憶。

items.title: 為甚麼Gen Z的測試成績正在下跌？
items.desc: 在全球最大的15歲青少年國際測試中，閱讀、數學和科學成績都正在下跌。這一下跌趨勢大約始於2012年，而且似乎正在加速，尤其是閱讀能力。本影片探討導致這一下跌的各種可能原因。

items.title: 「教員萬歲」：中國Z世代為何重新「擁抱」毛澤東？
items.desc: 分析認為，面對就業壓力和貧富差距，一些中國年輕人重新從毛澤東的階級論述尋找答案；毛時代強調的「獨立自主、自力更生」，在今日中西方競爭的背景下，也再次產生吸引力。

items.title: 董建華：從「船王」之子到香港首任行政長官
items.desc: 中國香港特區首任行政長官董建華逝世，享年89歲。「香港好，國家好」是他特首生涯中最為人熟知的一句說話。

items.title: 美軍航母全數撤離印太：台灣該擔心「空窗期」嗎？
items.desc: 專家稱，航母給美國盟友的是心理保證。印太區域沒有航母，「會加強一種整體感覺：美國正被中東局勢分心。」

items.title: 霍爾木茲海峽動盪，如何在巴拿馬運河引發中美角力？

items.title: 美國稱數十國助中國避特朗普關稅

items.title: 特習會後美中再現摩擦　「建設性穩定」能否撐到九月？

items.title: 中美俄的太空攻防戰：衛星如何成為現代戰爭的第一擊？

items.title: 董建華逝世：從船王富二代到香港首任特首，中共的「親密朋友」

items.title: 歐洲國家為何提走北美黃金儲備

items.title: 機器人開始索要小費，但錢到底進了誰的口袋？
items.desc: 自疫情以來，人們被索要小費的場合比以往任何時候都多，而且往往是由數字支付系統主動提示的。消費者抱怨這是一種「情感勒索」，而建議小費的百分比還在不斷攀升。儘管有些人嘲笑美國人「失控」的小費文化，但它正蔓延全球。

"Today we renew the sacred oath that we first swore in their names a quarter of a century ago. We will never, ever forget. That's why we fight today," said Trump, who opted to skip commemorations in New York.

items.title: REPLAY: Hegseth warns of 'Islamist threat' at 9/11 25th anniversary commemorations
items.desc: US defense secretary Pete Hegseth delivered remarks at a ceremony at the Pentagon on Friday on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. Hegseth used his speech to turn to the ongoing conflict in Iran and sought to connect it to the 2001 attacks on America. ““Our warriors have fought an Islamic theocracy that has wished us death for nearly half a century, that cheered on 9/11, a regime that has sponsored terrorist attacks against Americans for decades, killing thousands, including our comrades in Iraq, in Afghanistan," he said.

items.title: A fire destroys part of a migrant camp in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta
items.desc: An apparently accidental fire destroyed about 40 shacks at a migrant camp in Ceuta, local media reported, but caused no injuries, Spanish police told AFP on Friday. The North African enclave saw tens of thousands of migrants arrive from Morocco in late July.

items.title: Trump commemorates the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks at the Pentagon
items.desc: President Donald Trump  was set to observe Friday’s 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks by attending a ceremony at the Pentagon commemorating the lives lost when al-Qaida militants hijacked planes and killed nearly 3,000 people in three locations, upending American foreign policy and national security. Fraser Jackson reports from Washington.

items.title: Hate speech against Rohingya refugees on the rise in Malaysia
items.desc: Hostile social media content, disinformation campaigns, and a petition calling for their expulsion: in Malaysia, a wave of hate speech has been targeting Rohingya refugees, a Muslim minority driven out of Myanmar. The rising hostility has already led to the eviction of more than 100 people from a village and forced the temporary closure of schools serving refugee children.

items.title: Lens secure an epic comeback win to kick off their Champions League campaign
items.desc: Trailing 2-1 to Slavia Prague in the 88th minute, few could have imagined that Lens would go on to win. Yet, in just three minutes, the French side turned the game around, led by their captain Florian Thauvin.

items.title: 25 years after 9/11, al Qaeda remains a threat – even as Washington looks away
items.desc: A quarter of a century after the deadliest terrorist attacks in US history, al Qaeda’s various branches have moved away from the global jihad advocated by Osama bin Laden, focusing instead on regional insurgencies. Their actions continue to destabilise swathes of the world, from the Sahel to Afghanistan, neglected by a US administration that critics say has unlearned the lessons of 9/11.

REPLAY: 9/11 25th anniversary commemorations begin
items.desc: A moment of silence was held as an event to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 attacks began in New York on Friday at a memorial on the site of Ground Zero where the Twin Towers were destroyed.

items.title: Lebanon: Tremor recorded as Israel says destroyed key Hezbollah tunnels
items.desc: Israel said Thursday it demolished key tunnels built by the Iran-backed Hezbollah group beneath the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, triggering a 4.1-magnitude tremor.

items.title: French far-right leader polling ahead for 2027 election: should the EU be afraid?
items.desc: In Brussels, opinion polls coming out of France have not escaped attention. Two polls see far right leader Marine Le Pen beating all her likely rivals in the French presidential election, which is set to take place in April and May of next year.

items.title: Edgar Grospiron quits as 2030 French Alps Olympics chief amid setbacks
items.desc: Edgar Grospiron, the former moguls Olympic champion, has left the presidency of the 2030 Winter Olympics organising committee, French organisers said Thursday. Grospiron's decision to step down is the latest setback for organisers of the French Alps Olympics. A replacement was not immediately named.

items.title: 9/11, 25 years on: 'A time for reflection about the way the world has gone'
items.desc: Twenty-five years after the ​deadliest attack on US soil, Americans will pause on Friday to commemorate the nearly 3,000 people killed when hijacked planes slammed into the World Trade Center, the Pentagon and a field in Pennsylvania. But it is also a moment for the global community to reflect on the legacy of September 11 and the world has changed since, says France 24's Philip Turle.

items.title: More US lawmakers seek new AI rules after researchers warn of human extinction
items.desc: Growing numbers of U.S. lawmakers are calling for new rules to govern AI systems after dire warnings from two Anthropic researchers that rapidly progressing artificial intelligence could lead to the extinction of the human race in the not-too-distant future.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy case shines spotlight on postpartum psychosis
items.desc: In a special edition, we examine a case that has gripped the United States and sparked debate over postpartum mental health. Former nurse Lindsay Clancy from Massachusetts stood trial for the deaths of her three children. She said she was suffering from postpartum psychosis at the time and the court proceedings ended in a mistrial after the jury failed to reach a unanimous verdict. FRANCE 24's Annette Young speaks to Meghan Cliffel, who experienced postpartum psychosis after the birth of her second child, and Dr. Susan Hatters-Friedman, the psychiatrist who treated her.

items.title: Donald Trump absent as NYC marks 9/11 anniversary with first Muslim mayor
items.desc: New York marks the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks on Friday, with President Donald Trump absent as he attends a separate ceremony at the Pentagon. Zohran Mamdani, New Yorks first Muslim mayor, will be present, however, a fact that has irked some Republicans.

items.title: 'Somber mood' in Washington as US marks 9/11 anniversary
items.desc: The US marks the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks on Friday, with President Donald Trump attending a ceremony at the Pentagon while Vice President JD Vance and four former presidents join commemorations at Ground Zero, in New York, where victims’ relatives will read the names of those killed. France 24's Fraser Jackson has more.
